# Bluesky

5 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 5 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

| Endpoint | Cost | Returns | Use when |
|----------|------|---------|----------|
| [GET /v1/bluesky/post](#get-v1blueskypost---1-credit-standard) | 1 credit (standard) | Returns one Bluesky post's text, author, attachments, reply, repost, like and quote… | Use it when you have a post URL and want that post plus its reply thread in a single call. |
| [GET /v1/bluesky/profile](#get-v1blueskyprofile---1-credit-standard) | 1 credit (standard) | Returns a Bluesky account's public profile: display name, description, avatar, follower… | Use it when you have a handle such as espn.com and want the account snapshot before… |
| [GET /v1/bluesky/search](#get-v1blueskysearch---1-credit-standard) | 1 credit (standard) | Returns up to 100 public Bluesky posts matching a keyword, each with its text, author… | Use it to find what people post about a topic, newest first or top ranked, filtered by… |
| [GET /v1/bluesky/user/followers](#get-v1blueskyuserfollowers---1-credit-standard) | 1 credit (standard) | Returns the accounts that follow a Bluesky user, 100 a page, each with its did, handle… | Use it to list or walk an account's followers with the cursor; call profile for one… |
| [GET /v1/bluesky/user/posts](#get-v1blueskyuserposts---1-credit-standard) | 1 credit (standard) | Returns a Bluesky user's feed of posts, 30 a page, each with its text, author… | Use it for an account's posts, passing either handle or user_id (the did); narrow it… |

**Cheaper or broader options:** `prism/creator-card` - The same creator's profiles on several platforms in one call. `prism/profiles` - Up to 50 profiles per call, at the same price per profile, with the ones not found refunded.

## GET /v1/bluesky/post - 1 credit (standard)

Returns a single Bluesky post: record text, author info, embeds, replyCount, repostCount, likeCount, quoteCount, and a threaded `replies` array.

**Use when** you have a post URL and want that post plus its reply thread in a single call.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Bluesky post URL. · e.g. `https://bsky.app/profile/espn.com/post/3lqdfq7fkvm2g`

**Response** `Post` object at `data`, `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/Post.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |
| `computed.engagement_rate` | Computed engagement rate (0..1). |

+9 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {estimated_reach, language, save_rate}; `post.author` {avatar_url, display_name}; `post.engagement` {comments, likes, shares}; `post.flags` {deleted}. Also in the sample: `post` {url string}; `post.author` {verified boolean}; `post.ext` {hashtags null, mentions null}. Never filled: `post.content.duration_seconds`, `post.content.media_urls`, `post.content.thumbnail_url`, `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.views`, `post.flags.nsfw`, `post.flags.pinned`, `post.flags.spoiler`.

**Next** `bluesky/profile` (`handle` ← `data.post.author.username`) - Get a Bluesky profile.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bluesky/post" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://bsky.app/profile/espn.com/post/3lqdfq7fkvm2g" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/bluesky/profile - 1 credit (standard)

Returns a Bluesky user's public profile: handle, displayName, avatar, description, followersCount, followsCount, postsCount, createdAt, and verification status.

**Use when** you have a handle such as espn.com and want the account snapshot before pulling its posts.
**Cost** cache 900 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `handle` (required) - Bluesky handle (e.g. `espn.com`). · e.g. `espn.com`

**Response** `Author` object at `data`, `{ author, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/Author.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author.username` | User handle or username |
| `author.id` | Platform-specific user ID… |
| `author.avatar_url` | URL to profile picture |
| `author.bio` | Profile biography or description |
| `author.display_name` | Display name or full name |
| `author.followers` | Follower or subscriber count as an integer. |

+10 more (types in the full schema): `author` {following, joined_at, posts_count}; `computed` {content_category, engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language, save_rate}; `author.ext` {business_hours, products}. Also in the sample: `author` {verified boolean, url string}. Never filled: `author.likes_count`.

**Next** `bluesky/user/posts` (`handle` ← `data.author.username`) - List a Bluesky user's posts.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bluesky/profile" \
  --data-urlencode "handle=espn.com" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/bluesky/search - 1 credit (standard)

Searches public Bluesky posts by keyword and returns up to 100 posts in one page, in the unified Post shape under `data.items[]`: each item is `{ post: { id, url, content, author, engagement, flags, published_at } }`. `post.id` is the post's record key, `post.url` is its bsky.app permalink, `engagement.likes` / `comments` / `shares` are the like, reply and repost counts, and `published_at` is when the author wrote it. Newest first by default; `sort=top` uses Bluesky's top ranking instead. Narrow with `since` / `until`, `lang` and `author`. There is no cursor: to reach older posts with the default `sort=latest`, call again with `until` set to the oldest `published_at` you received. A query that matches nothing returns an empty `items` list.

**Use when** you want to find what people post about a topic, newest first or top ranked, filtered by date, language or author; set until to the oldest date to go further back.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** single page - Probed 23/09/2026: the unauthenticated upstream refuses every cursor request with an HTML 403 (6 of 6) and then briefly blocks the calling IP, so page 2 is unreachable. Older posts are reached by moving `until` back to the oldest `published_at`.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search terms matched against post text. · e.g. `espresso`
- `sort` (optional, enum: latest | top) - `latest` (newest first, the default) or `top` (Bluesky's own top ranking, which favours popular posts over recent ones).
- `since` (optional, string) - Only posts written at or after this time. ISO 8601 date (`2026-09-01`) or datetime with a timezone (`2026-09-01T00:00:00Z`); any other shape is rejected with a free 400.
- `until` (optional, string) - Only posts written before this time. Same format as `since`. Set it to the oldest `published_at` of your last call to fetch the next older batch; the boundary is compared to the second, so a post from that same second can repeat, and deduplicating on `post.id` removes it.
- `lang` (optional, string) - Only posts tagged with this language, as a code such as `en`, `ja` or `ko`.
- `author` (optional, string) - Only posts by this account: a handle such as `espn.com` or a `did` such as `did:plc:...`. An account that does not exist returns an empty list.

**Response** `PostList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/PostList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |
| `computed.engagement_rate` | Computed engagement rate (0..1). |

+9 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {estimated_reach, language, save_rate}; `post.author` {avatar_url, display_name}; `post.engagement` {comments, likes, shares}; `post.flags` {deleted}. Also in the sample: `post` {url string}; `post.author` {verified boolean}. Never filled: `post.content.duration_seconds`, `post.content.media_urls`, `post.content.thumbnail_url`, `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.views`, `post.flags.nsfw`, `post.flags.pinned`, `post.flags.spoiler`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bluesky/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=espresso" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/bluesky/user/followers - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the accounts that follow a Bluesky user, 100 a page, most recent followers first, each as a unified Author: `id` (the did), `username` (the handle), `display_name`, `avatar_url`, `bio`, `verified`, `joined_at` and the profile `url`. Follower rows carry no follower, following or post counts; call GET /v1/bluesky/profile for one account's counts. Pass either `handle` or `user_id` (a did), and pass the returned cursor back to walk the whole list. An account that does not exist answers 404.

**Use when** you want to list or walk an account's followers with the cursor; call profile for one account's follower and post counts.
**Cost** cache 300 s
**Paging** cursor · 100/page · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/100) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `handle` (optional, string) - Bluesky handle, for example espn.com. · e.g. `espn.com`
- `user_id` (optional, string) - Bluesky `did`, for example `did:plc:x7d6j54pm22ufehkes6jo4jf`.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Opaque cursor from the previous page.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `handle`, `user_id`.

**Response** `AuthorList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ author }` ([full schema](schemas/AuthorList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author.id` | Platform-specific user ID… |
| `author.username` | User handle or username |
| `author.avatar_url` | URL to profile picture |
| `author.bio` | Profile biography or description |
| `author.display_name` | Display name or full name |
| `author.joined_at` | When the account was created, as an ISO 8601 date… |

+2 more (types in the full schema): `author.ext` {business_hours, products}. Never filled: `author.followers`, `author.following`, `author.likes_count`, `author.posts_count`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bluesky/user/followers" \
  --data-urlencode "handle=espn.com" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/bluesky/user/posts - 1 credit (standard)

Returns a Bluesky user's feed, 30 posts a page, newest first with a pinned post on top: uri, record text, author info, embeds, replyCount, repostCount, likeCount, quoteCount, and indexedAt. Reposts appear in the feed as the original post. Pass either `handle` or `user_id` (Bluesky calls user IDs `did`). By default the feed holds the user's posts, their reposts and the threads they reply to themselves; `filter` narrows or widens it. Pass the returned cursor back to page further back through the whole history.

**Use when** you want it for an account's posts, passing either handle or user_id (the did); narrow it with filter, and pass the cursor back to page through the whole history.
**Cost** cache 600 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** cursor · 30/page · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/30) x 1 credits · typical 4.5-5.8 s

**Query params**

- `handle` (optional, string) - Bluesky handle. · e.g. `espn.com`
- `user_id` (optional, string) - Bluesky `did` (Bluesky's internal user ID format, e.g. `did:plc:x7d6j54pm22ufehkes6jo4jf`).
- `filter` (optional, enum: posts_and_author_threads | posts_with_replies | posts_no_replies | posts_with_media | posts_with_video) - Which posts the feed holds: `posts_and_author_threads` (the default: posts, reposts and self-threads), `posts_with_replies` (also replies to other people), `posts_no_replies` (no replies at all), `posts_with_media` (only posts with images or video), or `posts_with_video` (only posts with video).
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Opaque cursor from the previous page.
- `since` (optional, string) - Rows published from this date: YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601. Rows older than it are left off each page. This list is not in date order, so the walk does not stop at the date: keep following `next_cursor`, and each page costs what a page costs even when every row on it is filtered out. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until).
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages); `until` → [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until)

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `handle`, `user_id`.

**Response** `PostList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/PostList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |
| `computed.engagement_rate` | Computed engagement rate (0..1). |

+9 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {estimated_reach, language, save_rate}; `post.author` {avatar_url, display_name}; `post.engagement` {comments, likes, shares}; `post.flags` {deleted}. Also in the sample: `post` {url string}; `post.author` {verified boolean}; `post.ext` {hashtags null, mentions null}. Never filled: `post.content.duration_seconds`, `post.content.media_urls`, `post.content.thumbnail_url`, `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.views`, `post.flags.nsfw`, `post.flags.pinned`, `post.flags.spoiler`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bluesky/user/posts" \
  --data-urlencode "handle=espn.com" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
